newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong stocks seen easier ahead of land auction.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks seen easier ahead of land auction.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks are seen moving lower in sideways trading on Tuesday with investors waiting for the government land auction starting this afternoon at 2.30 p.m. (0630 gmt), brokers said.

"Stock prices are at high levels and profit-taking pressure is likely to cap the index below the 15,000 mark," said Edwin Cheung, dealing director at Taiwan Securities. He saw the Hang Seng Index moving in a 100-150 point range before the acution.
The Hang Seng Index hit another record close at 14,990.90 on Monday, up 233.09 points, or 1.58 percent. The Hang Seng London Reference Index later eased 44.41 points to 14,946.49.
